highlights: 账号卡片显示剩余额度，从100%绿色至0%红色渐变，重置时间保留上游原文。
新增每日超限清理设置：媒体与诊断日志分别设上限/目标，按最老文件优先，默认关闭，重启不重复执行当日检查。
统一账号登录入口，批量验证码登录优先，手动Cookie与扩展工具折叠保留为高级兼容方式。
移除首页热升级宣传和后台静默升级，只保留本仓库正式Release的手动只读版本检查。
扩展仍为1.0.2、油猴脚本1.1.2，已有插件无需重装；旧版仍需手动在每个浏览器个人资料中升级。
highlights_en: Quota cards show remaining balance, gradually colored from green at 100% to red at 0%, retaining upstream reset text.
Optional daily FIFO retention checks media and diagnostics separately, only deleting over their configured limits; disabled by default and claimed once per local day across restarts.
Account login combines batch OTP login with collapsed advanced Cookie and extension import tools.
Removed the homepage upgrade/promotional box and all silent code updates; only explicit read-only release checks against this maintained fork remain.
Extension remains 1.0.2 and userscript 1.1.2; older extensions still require a manual upgrade in every browser profile.
